verdict.rationale: Secureframe's MCP server uses an OAuth-style flow where each agent client gets its own token after the user signs in and approves access, so no shared secret is stored in config files (secureframe-docs-59, secureframe-docs-58, secureframe-docs-37). A credential path for headless CI or scripts is also mentioned (secureframe-docs-38). The evidence never shows that these tokens can be limited to specific scopes, permissions or read-only access, which is the core of the least-privilege story. Missing for 10: documented permission scopes or role limits for API/MCP tokens, read-only or per-resource credential options, per-agent revocation and expiry controls, independent corroboration.
